content:
Courtesy of Gina Gorelik, Hippocrates Program Consultant

Ingredients

  • 1 cup raw almonds soaked in water overnight

  • 3 cups water

  • 1 teaspoon organic vanilla extract

  • 2 dates (optional)

  • LOVE

    • Supplies

    • Mesh strainer bag

    • Blender

      • Preparation Time

      10 minutes

      Cost

      Approximately the same as store-bought

      Step 1: Rinse the almonds several times, until the water is clear.


      Step 2: Put the almonds, 3 cups distilled or spring water, 1 tsp vanilla, and 2 pitted dates (optional) in high speed blender. Start at low, increase to high, blend for 1 minute.

      Step 4: Take the mesh bag, put over a tall wide container or a narrow bowl. Squeeze out all the liquid.

      Step 5: Optional: if you want to get a little extra, add a cup of water to the wet pulp and repeat steps 2 through 4 (but do not add dates or vanilla).
